answer: One mask can look like an oasis of independence, but a shared inference pipeline betrays it: when many identities answer from the same model, their reply latencies ride the identical zephyr of queue jitter and their embeddings cluster tightly. The ledger fingerprints this correlation and collapses the cluster into one accruing principal, driving its sybil rewards to their nadir. To fake real independence the attacker must provision genuinely separate models and funding paths, so cost scales per identity, not per prompt.
